speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
text: TAFEP defines Tripartite Standards as a set of good employment practices and it actually recognises that employers that adopt the Tripartite Standards are progressive employers.

speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
text: Given that there is a lot of interest in ESG, I am wondering whether there could, perhaps be more, affirmative plans on how this could be integrated from the local context in the ESG reporting for local companies that are listed with SGX.

speaker: Ms See Jinli Jean (Nominated Member)
text: So, are there affirmative plans which the Ministry or the Government is looking at to make this a part of what SGX requires of listed companies?
